extracted.intended_audience: editors, writers, proofreaders, and typesetters using the Chicago Manual of Style
extracted.subtask_description: Rules and typographic conventions (capitalization, punctuation, quotation, hyphenation, divisions, type specimens, and related editorial decisions) drawn from the Chicago Manual of Style. Useful for preparing, editing, and typesetting scholarly and book-length manuscripts.

rubrics_metrics.name: "United States": spelling vs. abbreviation
rubrics_metrics.description: "United States": when to be spelled out, 103; when to be abbreviated, 103.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies contexts (see p.103) where 'United States' should appear spelled out versus abbreviated; page-number cross-reference provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: University of Chicago: capitalization of institutional terms
rubrics_metrics.description: University of Chicago: capitalization of special terms dealing with organization, administration, and curricula of, 49; of titles of divisions, departments, officers, and courses and units of study, in official work dealing with, 49.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives rules for capitalizing organizational and curricular terms and official titles when referring to University of Chicago contexts (see p.49).

rubrics_metrics.name: Quotation marks for unusual words or phrases
rubrics_metrics.description: Unusual word or phrase, use of quotation marks for, 77.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advises use of quotation marks to signal an unusual word or phrase (see p.77) — i.e., to call attention or indicate nonstandard usage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Treatment of the particle "Van"
rubrics_metrics.description: "Van," rule for treatment of, 3, 240.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives the recommended editorial/typographic treatment for names beginning with 'Van' (see rules at pp.3 and 240).

rubrics_metrics.name: Capitalization of verbs in titles and verbs derived from proper names
rubrics_metrics.description: Verbs: capitalization of, in titles of publications, 41; derived from proper names, how to treat, 53.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains when verbs should be capitalized in titles (p.41) and how to treat verbs formed from proper names (p.53).

rubrics_metrics.name: Verse/page fractional-letter formatting
rubrics_metrics.description: Verse or page, letter affixed to number of, to denote fractional part: to be set in italic, 66; spacing of, 66.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Letters appended to page/verse numbers (to denote fractional parts) should be set in italic and spacing conventions are specified (see p.66).

rubrics_metrics.name: Bible versions: abbreviations and capitalization
rubrics_metrics.description: Versions of Bible: abbreviations for, 109; capitalization of, 30.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules for how to abbreviate Bible versions (p.109) and how to capitalize version names (p.30).

rubrics_metrics.name: Verso (definition)
rubrics_metrics.description: Verso, defined, 283.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives the definition/usage note for 'verso' (see p.283) — useful for page references and collation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Versus (v.) entry
rubrics_metrics.description: Versus (v.), 59.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides guidance on use/abbreviation 'v.' for 'versus' (see p.59).

rubrics_metrics.name: Treatment of prefix "Vice" in titles
rubrics_metrics.description: "Vice," prefixed to titles, how to treat, 30x.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains capitalization or punctuation when 'Vice' is prefixed to titles (see indicated section around p.30).

rubrics_metrics.name: Vocative "O"
rubrics_metrics.description: Vocative, "O," x17.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives rules for punctuation/capitalization of the vocative 'O' (see indicated entry).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of numerals with abbreviations in literary references
rubrics_metrics.description: "Vol.," "chap.," "p.," etc., in literary references: use of numerals with, 337; when omitted, 337.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies when to use numerals with abbreviations like 'vol.' 'chap.' 'p.' in references and when such abbreviations may be omitted (see p.337).

rubrics_metrics.name: Treatment of the particle "Von"
rubrics_metrics.description: "Von," rule for treatment of, 3, 340.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives editorial/typographic rules for names beginning with 'Von' (see pp.3 and 340).

rubrics_metrics.name: Syllable division (hyphenation) rules — vowels
rubrics_metrics.description: Vowel: divide on, whenever possible. 324; single, forming separate syllable in middle of words, to be put in first line in dividing, 324.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules for breaking words across lines: prefer dividing on vowels when possible; a single vowel that forms a separate syllable in the middle of a word should be placed at the end of the preceding line (see p.324).

rubrics_metrics.name: Metric weights and measures: designation and spacing
rubrics_metrics.description: Weights and measures, metric: how to designate, iii; spacing of, 269.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides conventions for expressing metric measures (designation) and spacing practices (see preface/intro iii and p.269).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of capital/small caps for "Whereas" in resolutions
rubrics_metrics.description: "Whereas," in resolutions, use of cap and small caps for, 51.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advises using capitals and small caps for the word 'Whereas' in formal resolutions (see p.51).

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoiding wide spacing
rubrics_metrics.description: Wide spacing, where to avoid, 365.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates typographic situations where wide spacing should be avoided (see p.365 for specifics).

rubrics_metrics.name: Quoting a word or phrase when accompanied by its definition or to draw attention
rubrics_metrics.description: Word or phrase: accompanied by its definition, to be quoted, 76; to which attention is directed, use of quotation marks for, 79.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use quotation marks when a word/phrase is followed by its definition (p.76) or when drawing the reader's attention to that word/phrase (p.79).

rubrics_metrics.name: Hyphenated words and variant spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Words: hyphenated, list of, 214; of more than one spelling, how to spell, 119.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists commonly hyphenated words (p.214) and provides preferred spellings when multiple spellings exist (p.119).

rubrics_metrics.name: Compounds with "Work"
rubrics_metrics.description: "Work," compounds of, 186.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives rules for forming and punctuating compounds involving 'work' (see p.186).

rubrics_metrics.name: Titles of works of art: roman-quoted
rubrics_metrics.description: Works of art, titles of, to be roman-quoted, 84.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies that titles of works of art should be set in roman type and enclosed in quotation marks (see p.84).

rubrics_metrics.name: Compounds with "World"
rubrics_metrics.description: "World," compounds of, 192.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives guidelines on forming and capitalizing compounds containing 'world' (see p.192).

rubrics_metrics.name: Zoological terms: capitalization and italics
rubrics_metrics.description: Zoological terms: use of capitals in, 46 of italics, 71.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules for capitalizing zoological names and for italicizing scientific names (see pp.46 and 71).

rubrics_metrics.name: Specimens of types in use (typeface, point size, leading, emphasis)
rubrics_metrics.description: SPECIMENS OF TYPES IN USE — various typefaces and point sizes shown (Modern, Old Style, Monotype, etc.), with indications such as [Leaded] or [Solid] and examples of all-caps, small caps, italics, and spacing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides practical specimens demonstrating how different typefaces, point sizes, and leading (leaded vs. solid) render the same text; shows conventions for emphasis (ALL CAPS, small caps, italics), numerals, and spacing to guide typographic choices in book design.
